text:
Lina: Heads up 10x retail POC wants to buy through GCP Marketplace but their AP insists the invoice show Redwood Inference as vendor (not Google). They also want PO on the invoice. Anyone handled this recently?

Ravi: GCP marketplace invoices to buyers are issued by Google. For direct Redwood invoices we need a private/partner offer or to transact off-marketplace. Mapping PO through marketplace sometimes passes via the order metadata but its flaky.

Sam: Quick options: 1) Private Offer (GCP partner ops) to have invoice routed to our entity; takes ~5-10 business days. 2) CC for POC, convert to PO on commit. 3) Have customer accept Google invoice and we issue a pro-forma/credit note to them.

Margo: Procurement asked for TaxID + W-9 and example invoice showing PO passing through. I'll prep an example and attach.

ProcureBot: Checklist:
- Vendor legal name and W-9 or EU VAT cert
- Billing contact and remit address
- PO number format
- SOW line-item breakdown to match invoice
Upload link: https://procurement.10xretail/upload

Ravi: Note on timing: marketplace payout cadence is monthly with net-30/60 settlements to us. Revenue recognition for them depends on whos invoicing. If they need Redwood on the invoice for internal accounting, Private Offer is the cleanest path.

Lina: Deal Desk path? How fast to request a partner/private-offer carve-out and any chance of accelerated setup for POC?

Sam: Open a Deal Desk ticket with: customer name, SOW, desired billing entity, proposed price/discount, and attach W-9. Tag @legal and @partner-ops. Expect initial response 24-72 hours; partner ops timing is the gating factor.

Margo: I'll draft SOW with separate lines (licenses vs infra) so AP can match. Also will include their PO format.

Lina: Action items: Margo 1 attach draft SOW by tomorrow 11am; Sam 1 open Deal Desk ticket and cc legal; Ravi 1 confirm settlement cadence and include sample invoice. If Deal Desk says no, we'll fall back to CC POC.

Sam: Opening ticket now.

Ravi: Sample vendor info to include in ticket:
```
Redwood Inference, Inc.
EIN: 12-3456789
Billing: 123 Redwood Way, San Francisco, CA 94107
W-9: available on request
```

Margo: Got it. Attaching SOW draft once done.

Lina: Thanks all. Will keep this thread for updates. :thumbsup:
